bio: Instructor Office of Education, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health Other Positions Lecturer, Adjunct Faculty Members, Harvard Kennedy School Greg Harris has taught writing at Harvard University for 19 years, in the College, the John F Kennedy School of Government, and the T.H. Chan School of Public Health. Greg is founding editor of Pangyrus Literary Magazine, and founding director of Harvard literary festival Harvard LITfest. His essays, reviews, and stories have appeared or are forthcoming in the Washington Post, Boston Globe, the Chronicle of Higher Education, Harvard Review, Earth Island Journal, and elsewhere. A 2011 Fulbright Fellow, he holds an MFA in Creative Writing. His translation of Jazz, Perfume, and the Incident by Seno Gemira Ajidarma is part of the Modern Library of Indonesia.
